title: Associate Programme Manager - Air Defence
description:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.   
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.   
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers.  We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.   
 The role 
 As (Associate) Programme Manager – Air Defence, you will help shape and align Helsing's strategic partnerships and customer programmes in air defence. You will work directly with industry partners, procurement agencies and Armed Forces. You will support the business strategy, vision and roadmap for current and future air defence programmes. You will start by understanding customer demand in depth, then use that insight to develop existing and new opportunities for collaboration with Armed Forces and the defence industry. You will work with delivery teams at the intersection of technical and commercial delivery, and you will be accountable for the success of the projects you work on. You will join a partnerships and programmes team that brings together many fields of expertise and backgrounds. Together, the team shapes how industry partners and customers think about software and AI in defence, national security and intelligence. You will learn from leading experts and build lasting relationships with industry and customers.
 The day-to-day 
 Support market activities in air defence by engaging external stakeholders and building lasting industry partnerships
 Anticipate market trends and customer needs, and turn them into new business opportunities with Armed Forces, procurement agencies and industry partners
 Support strategic campaigns by managing the activities and actions needed to deliver against Helsing's strategic goals
 Track progress against Helsing's strategic goals on each of your projects, and flag risks early so that delivery and business outcomes stay on course
 Work closely with delivery teams to keep technical delivery and commercial commitments aligned, from first engagement through to execution
 Report to an experienced senior member of the team and learn from them as your responsibilities grow
 You should apply if you 
 Have worked on projects or programmes in the defence sector, the public sector or a consultancy
 Have delivered work to a high quality standard and presented its status clearly to internal and external stakeholders
 Have contributed to delivering software-based capabilities to operators in collaboration with established industry partners
 Work collaboratively with colleagues, partners and customers, and solve problems together
 Take ownership of your projects and act on your own initiative to move them forward
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to have 
 Have applied academic knowledge from a relevant field, such as aerospace engineering, business administration, political science or data science
 Have served in the military, particularly in air defence or related operational roles
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields   
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 Relocation support : up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
 Learning : €500/£450 yearly allowance
 Health & wellness : gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
 Social : regularly company events and monthly social allowances
 Enhanced parental leave : 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work
 These are the core benefits across all

title: Senior Product Manager - Bookkeeping
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?
Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?
Are our Product Principles https://medium.com/pennylane-engineering/pennylanes-product-team-6-key-principles-b2885582769c aligned with your vision?
Then Pennylane is the right place for you !
Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).
We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.
About us
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)
In almost 7 years of existence, we’ve managed to :
💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings https://www.google.com/search?q=pennylane&ei=O9pOYvm0Co-blwSmhKmIAw&ved=0ahUKEwi5vsWL-4H3AhWPzYUKHSZCCjEQ4dUDCA4&uact=5&oq=pennylane&gs_lcp=Cgdnd3Mtd2l6EAMyDQgAEIAEELEDEIMBEAoyCwguEIAEEMcBEK8BMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgUIABCABDIFCAAQgAQyBQgAEIAEMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKMgcIABCABBAKOgcIABBHELADOgkIABCwAxAKEEM6CgguEMcBEK8BEAo6BggAEBYQHjoICAAQFhAKEB46DQguEIAEEMcBEK8BEApKBAhBGABKBAhGGABQ7QFY6wVgugdoAXABeACAAUiIAbMCkgEBNZgBAKABAcgBCcABAQ&sclient=gws-wiz
🚀 Already more than 1M+ small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!
WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission
Autopilot is Pennylane’s AI add-on for accounting firms, designed to automate bookkeeping and move accountants from execution to supervision—with a clear ambition: a 1-click VAT return.
The challenge is no longer only to build a powerful product, but to activate it at scale, prove its value and turn adoption into revenue.
As the first PM of the new Bookkeeping / Autopilot Growth squad, you will play a central role in making that happen. You will help hundreds of thousands of companies adopt Autopilot, connect firms to the value it already delivers and shape Pennylane’s AI monetization strategy.
HOW you will contribute to the company as a Product Manager
As a Senior Product Manager, you will join a 100+ person Product organization, working with 300+ engineers to make Autopilot the default way firms run their bookkeeping.
You will:
 - Understand what drives adoption. Talk to firm owners and accountants, analyse product data with SQL, Amplitude and Metabase, and identify where firms hesitate to activate Autopilot.
 - Turn insights into measurable growth. Define clear hypotheses, metrics and stop criteria, then run B2B experiments through holdouts, cohort analysis and staged rollouts.
 - Own the growth strategy. Set your OKRs, shape the roadmap and focus the squad on the initiatives that drive activation, trust, usage and revenue.
 - Build with a cross-functional squad. Partner closely with a Product Designer, Engineering Manager and product-focused engineers, starting with MVPs and iterating based on what you learn.
 - Work across the ecosystem. Collaborate with the squads building Bookkeeping and Autopilot, as well as Data, Product Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success and Account Management.
 - Scale adoption beyond the product. Design in-product and lifecycle experiences that help firms self-serve, while providing commercial teams with the signals they need to support adoption.
 - Build for France and Germany from day one. Design configurable solutions rather than simple translations, and work with the German team to make what works in France scalable internationally.
 - Help define a new way of building product. Work agentic-first, design for supervision and stay relentlessly user-obsessed—using AI tools and agents every day to explore data, prototype and move faster.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM YOUR LIFE AT PENNYLANE
WITHIN ONE MONTH
 - You'll learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week
 - You'll familiarize yourself with the product, the accounting industry and the accountant channel (you will have access to a lot of documentation and will attend trainings organized by your peers)
 - You'll understand how Autopilot works: what it automates, how confident it is, and where it still needs a human
 - You'll have mapped the Autopilot adoption funnel, at company and firm level: eligible, enabled, expanded, paying
WITHIN 3 MONTHS
 - You'll have set the adoption baseline and targets with your manager
 - You'll have shipped and read your first experiments on activation, hand in hand with your Product Designer and Engineers
 - You'll have impacted positively at least one OKR
 - You will have set up your continuous discovery routine with firms and be ready to build your roadmap
WITHIN 6 MONTHS
 - You'll be autonomous at defining your OKRs and your roadmap
 - You'll have shipped at least one step change in how firms activate Autopilot
 - You'll have made the time Autopilot saves visible to firm owners
 - You'll have prepared the switch to paid with Pricing, Product Marketing and Sales
 - You'll have equipped Account Manage

title: Senior Product Manager (R14206)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India
 Who We Are 
 Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. 
 Location Note 
 We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. 
 The Opportunity 
 Oportun is seeking a talented, customer-focused, and analytical Senior Product Manager to join the Servicing & Payments team. You will help create a trusted post-disbursement experience that strengthens members' confidence in Oportun, supports their financial health, and encourages continued engagement and repeat member behavior. 
 You will define product strategy, set measurable objectives and key results, create outcome-oriented roadmaps, and partner with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, and other teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. You will help make repayment easy, intelligent, successful, and accurately reflected for lending members. 
 At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. 
 What You'll Do 
 Your day-to-day 
 You'll define and execute product strategy and roadmaps that improve repayment outcomes, member trust, and repeat engagement. 
 You'll own initiatives end to end - from discovery and requirements through delivery, measurement, and iteration. 
 You'll create simple, transparent, and reliable servicing and payment experiences across self-service and assisted channels. 
 You'll use member insights, data, and experimentation to improve payer rate, payment success, DQ prevention, and lending-member NPS. 
 You'll lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, legal, and finance. 
 You'll communicate product strategy, trade-offs, progress, and measurable business impact to senior stakeholders. 
 You'll bring ideas for how we can do things better - proactively, not just when asked. 
 You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully - to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster. 
 Who You Are 
 The right fit looks like this 
 You're customer-focused and analytical, with a track record of navigating complex problems and turning member needs and data into practical product decisions. You're collaborative, communicate clearly, and build consensus across a wide range of cross-functional partners. 
 You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. 
 What You Bring 
 Skills & experience 
 You'll have 5+ years of product management experience in high-growth environments. 
 You've demonstrated experience partnering with business executives and cross-functional teams across compliance, risk, operations, fraud, technology, business intelligence, finance, training, legal, and cybersecurity. 
 You bring strong analytical problem-solving skills, including experience with data-informed decision making, testing and experimentation, metric definition, and data analysis. 
 You've demonstrated a track record of shipping and iterating on impactful products while building consensus across a broad group of cross-functional partners. 
 You bring strong product execution skills and the ability to help teams push through obstacles and blockers to deliver value for members. 
 You communicate clearly and concisely and have strong documentation skills. 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience launching products within complex legal and regulatory frameworks, including financial services. 
 Experience with SQL. 
 Experience working with a multinational workforce. 
 You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity. 
 Our AI Mindset 
 We build with AI. We lead with judgment. 
 AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 
 We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be  open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 
 In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. 
 WORKING AT OPORTUN

title: Senior Product Manager – Universal KYC (MetaMask Passport)
description:
Headquarters: EMEA - Remote, UNITED STATES - Remote
 Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. 
 Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.  Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.
 About MetaMask 
 MetaMask is building a future where users can unlock the full product stack through a single, seamless identity experience, enabling access to all features with trust, safety, and minimal friction.
 Today, identity verification is fragmented across several product and onboarding experiences. Users are repeatedly asked to verify themselves across different services, creating unnecessary friction, inconsistent outcomes, and degraded trust.
 Universal KYC (UKYC) is a new initiative to solve this problem by creating a single, reusable identity layer across MetaMask. At the centre of this is MetaMask Passport , a product designed to enable users to verify once and unlock multiple experiences across the MetaMask ecosystem.
 This role sits at the intersection of platform and product experience . You will define the primitives, standards, and user journeys that make identity verification seamless, privacy-conscious, and globally compliant.
 What you’ll do 
 You will own the vision and roadmap for Universal KYC and MetaMask Passport, defining how a reusable identity layer unlocks the broader MetaMask product stack. You will build the underlying identity platform, creating scalable verification primitives and standards that can be adopted across products. In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. You will drive adoption across MetaMask by partnering closely with internal teams to integrate a consistent identity layer, while balancing privacy, trust, and global regulatory requirements. Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes.
 What we are looking for: 
 Proven experience building or scaling identity verification (IDV), KYC, or onboarding products 
 Strong background in fintech , ideally with exposure to Web3 
 Hands-on experience working with identity verification providers (IDV vendors) such as Sumsub, Veriff, Onfido, Persona, or Stripe Identity
 Familiarity with compliance workflows , including KYC, KYB, and customer due diligence (CDD) processes
 Track record of delivering platform products adopted across multiple teams 
 Ability to operate across both technical systems and user experience 
 What Success looks like: 
 Increased KYC completion rates and reduced onboarding friction
 Reduced time-to-first-transaction across KYC-gated flows
 Increased reuse of verified identity across products
 Improved transaction success rate through consistent verification outcomes
 Strong user trust with minimal friction and compliant execution
 Attributes that will make you stand out 
 First-principles thinker with strong product judgment
 Deep user empathy with a focus on reducing friction and cognitive load
 Strong understanding of trust, privacy, and compliance trade-offs
 Clear, structured communicator who drives alignment and momentum
 High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguity
 Why This Role Matters 
 Universal KYC is a foundational unlock for MetaMask, enabling users to move from fragmented, repetitive identity verification to a seamless, reusable experience across the entire product stack. It establishes a scalable, privacy-conscious identity layer that strengthens user trust while meeting global compliance requirements. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of access, trust, and growth, critical to unlocking the next phase of MetaMask’s evolution.
 Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role . 
 The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range. 
 US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits) $130,000 — $187,000 USD In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

title: Senior Product Manager, Ad Monetization

RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 
 We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

 This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

 You deeply understand the mechanics of mobile ad monetization, including how publisher inventory, demand sources, auctions, pricing, mediation, and measurement interact.
 You understand the incentives of the different participants in the ad ecosystem and can reason about both the technical and commercial implications of product decisions.
 You are excited about RevenueCat's mission to help developers make more money and about expanding that mission beyond subscriptions.
 You have an entrepreneurial mindset and are excited to take an initiative with early traction and help turn it into a significant product area.

 You have demonstrated the ability to ship and learn quickly, including finding pragmatic solutions to hard problems with many constraints.

 At Airalo , we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

 We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.
 Your Next Destination

 Contract: Full-time, permanent.

You will define the roadmap, shape the technical direction with engineering and architecture partners, and lead discovery and execution across multiple squads and stakeholder groups.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.
 This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.
 What you'll be doing 
 Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
 Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
 Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
 Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
 Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. 
 What you'll need 
 Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
 Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap 
 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch 
 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds 
 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted 
 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

#### **Good to know...**
**Hybrid · Berlin HQ (Prenzlauer Berg) · Full-time · Reports to the Head of Product Management, BI & CRM**
Our core product team builds what makes Pets Deli different: the Pet Profile, our recommendation logic and the personalised journey to the right food. This role builds on that core instead of owning it and takes it to where growth happens. You own the product side of growth: everything in our shop and systems that connects us to the channels and markets where customers find us, compare us and buy from us.
Today these topics sit between marketing, engineering and management. They work, but they run on the side and nobody owns them end to end. You will. You sit in the product team, work with our engineers every day, and are the product counterpart for our acquisition team, our growth and country managers, and our agencies and partners.
We don't work with long roadmaps. We work in a cycle of hypotheses, experiments and learning. For every idea we look for the Minimum Measurable Product: the smallest investment that tells us whether it creates value. Full focus goes only to what proves itself.
#### **Your tasks**
These topics need an owner. Nobody expects you to cover all of them from day one. We decide together where the impact is highest, and your scope grows from there.
* **Product feeds and marketplaces.** Google Merchant Center, Meta catalogues and our other feeds. You make sure what we show outside the shop is correct, relevant and sells, and you develop the feeds as channels change. That means understanding both what each channel needs and our own setup, from assortment to pricing.
* **Tracking and attribution.** You know how our tracking fits together, from GA4 and Tag Manager to server-side tracking, consent and conversion APIs. Engineering, BI and our agency implement it. You set the priorities and get everyone to numbers marketing can trust.
* **Markets.** We sell in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and, since this year, the Netherlands. You own each market's setup in our shop and systems: localisation, prices, payment methods, legal texts, delivery information. For a new launch you hold the threads together across teams, and where a market has no country manager yet, you take on more yourself.
* **Channels and user experience.** You enable the landing page strategy of our acquisition team, and you bring our strengths, from the Pet Profile to our recommendations, into every market and channel, personalised where needed.
* **Reviews and trust.** Our review platforms, how we collect reviews and where we show them in the customer journey.
* **SEO and structured data.** You are the technical contact for our SEO partners: markups, structured data, page setup.
**Topics you can grow into later:** operations and delivery, together with our fulfilment centre (from delivery times to out-of-stock logic), and conversion, checkout and payment in our shop.

title: Project Manager (ILS/IPS)
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
**Department Overview**
-----------------------
Motorola Solutions is a global leader in mission-critical communications and public safety technologies. Within our Defense & Tactical Systems division, we equip armed forces with resilient command, control, and tactical communications systems (TETRA, mission-critical broadband, C4ISR). To ensure long-term operational readiness, material maintenance, and comprehensive through-life support for our communication systems aboard German Navy platforms (frigates, corvettes, submarines, and naval shore stations), we are seeking a qualified Project Manager (ILS/IPS) (m/f/d).
**Job Description**
-------------------
In this pivotal role, you will take full ownership of Integrated Logistics and Product Support across the entire system lifecycle—from development and procurement through commissioning, operational deployment, and naval in-service support:
* **Overall Logistics Planning:** Develop, coordinate, and maintain the **Integrated Logistics / Product Support Plan (ILSP / IPSP)** in alignment with customer requirements ( **Defence** ), **V-Modell XT Bund** guidelines, and international specifications (e.g., ASD/AIA SX000i).
* **Logistics Support Analysis (LSA):** Coordinate and conduct Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety ( **RAMS / FMECA** ) analyses in accordance with **S3000L** and MIL-HDBK-502 to optimize preventative maintenance routines and repair concepts.
* **Spare Parts Management & Provisioning:** Define initial and replenishment spare parts packages ( **S2000M / NATO Codification** ) for onboard allowances and shipyard maintenance periods in coordination with naval arsenals and supply depots.
* **Technical Documentation:** Supervise the development, quality assurance, and formal delivery of Interactive Electronic Technical Documentation ( **IETD according to S1000D** and German Bundeswehr documentation standards) for system operation and maintenance.
* **Life Cycle Cost (LCC) & Obsolescence Management:** Monitor life cycle costs, identify end-of-life/obsolescence risks early, and submit engineering change recommendations to the **Change Control Board (CCB)** in close collaboration with Configuration Management.
* **Stakeholder & Quality Assurance Liaison:** Serve as the technical logistics point of contact for the German Defence project management team, the Bundeswehr Quality Assurance Service (under contractual AQAP quality standards), naval shipyards, and system sub-suppliers.
**Basic Requirements**
----------------------
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Logistics Management, Systems Engineering, or a comparable military-technical background (e.g., former naval weapons/communications officer).
* **Professional Experience:** Proven track record in **Integrated Logistics Support (ILS)** , **Integrated Product Support (IPS)** , or through-life technical service management for complex systems—ideally within the **naval, defense, or aerospace industry** .
* **Standards & Specifications:** Thorough working knowledge of the ASD/AIA S-Series suite ( **S1000D, S2000M, S3000L** ) and familiarity with German defense procurement and lifecycle processes (CPM, V-Modell XT Bund).
* **System Understanding:** Good technical grasp of shipboard communication and tactical radio networks, interfaces to combat systems, and the operating environments of naval platforms.
* **Methods & Tools:** Experience with LSA databases, ERP systems, and PLM/ALM tools to ensure seamless data alignment for the *As-Maintained* configuration state.
* **Languages:** Professional business proficiency in German (for customer negotiations and local naval documentation) and fluent English (written and spoken).
* **Due to the specific requirements of the project, candidates interested in this position will be required to undergo a background check in accordance with applicable legal requirements. German or EU citizenship may be required, depending on the applicable requirements.**

None

-----------------------
None

Experienced

-------------------------
No

-----------
Motorola Solutions Germany GmbH

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.
We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. title: AI Transformation & Project Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung
 MSL ist eine der profiliertesten Kommunikationsberatungen in Deutschland. Als Teil der internationalen Publicis Groupe arbeiten wir eng vernetzt mit unseren Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Kommunikationsdisziplinen – von der Werbung über Media bis zu Markenentwicklung.

MSL hat Büros in Hamburg, Frankfurt, München, Düsseldorf und Berlin.
 Wir suchen AB SOFORT eine*n AI TRANSFORMATION & PROJECT MANAGER (w/m/d)
 Vollzeit
 Diese Position wird vorzugsweise an unserem Standort Berlin besetzt.
 Stellenbeschreibung
 KI verändert, wie wir Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation und Agenturarbeit denken und organisieren. Bei MSL sind wir bereits mitten in dieser Transformation: Wir nutzen KI in unterschiedlichen Bereichen, entwickeln neue Workflows und Use Cases und bauen unsere Arbeitsweisen kontinuierlich weiter aus.
Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Schritt gehen. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere KI-Transformation mit hoher Umsetzungskompetenz weiter vorantreibt. Du steuerst Projekte, bringst relevante Stakeholder zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen funktionierende Lösungen werden und aus Pilotprojekten neue Arbeitsweisen.
Dabei musst Du nicht programmieren können. Entscheidend ist, dass Du neugierig auf neue Technologien bist, ihre Möglichkeiten verstehen willst und sehr gut darin bist, komplexe Projekte zu strukturieren und konsequent umzusetzen.
Kurzum: Wir suchen einen richtig guten Projektmanager, der KI spannend findet. Nicht einen KI-Experten, der auch Projektmanagement kann.
 Verantwortlichkeiten
 Deine Aufgaben
 Du steuerst konkrete Projekte unserer KI-Roadmap und sorgst dafür, dass sie strukturiert und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
 Du identifizierst gemeinsam mit der Agenturführung sowie unseren Business Units und Practices relevante KI-Use-Cases, bewertest und priorisierst sie und hilfst dabei, sie von der Idee über den Piloten bis in die Anwendung.
 Du analysierst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams bestehende Prozesse und entwickelst KI-gestützte Workflows, die unsere Arbeit einfacher, schneller oder besser machen.
 Du unterstützt dabei, erfolgreiche Ansätze zu standardisieren und für weitere Teams skalierbar zu machen.
 Du begleitest Trainings, Enablement und Adoption und hilfst dabei, dass neue Lösungen nicht nur eingeführt, sondern im Arbeitsalltag tatsächlich genutzt werden.
 Qualifikationen
 Was solltest Du mitbringen?
 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise im Umfeld von Digitalisierung oder Prozessoptimierung.
 Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, komplexe Projekte mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern eigenständig zu strukturieren und erfolgreich umzusetzen.
 Ein hohes Maß an Umsetzungsstärke und Verbindlichkeit: Du hältst Themen nach, erkennst Hindernisse frühzeitig und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheidungen getroffen und Projekte abgeschlossen werden.
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Microsoft-365-Umfeld, insbesondere in SharePoint und Teams.
 Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 Copilot und Grundkenntnisse in Power Automate oder vergleichbaren No-/Low-Code-Anwendungen.
 Technologieaffinität und Neugier: Du probierst neue Lösungen selbst aus und kannst ihre Relevanz für konkrete Aufgaben und Prozesse einschätzen.
 Du hast ein Bewusstsein für einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit KI und berücksichtigst bestehende Vorgaben zu Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und Governance in deinen Projekten.
 Eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie gute Kommunikations-fähigkeiten.
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
 Programmierkenntnisse erwarten wir ausdrücklich nicht. Wichtiger ist uns, dass Du Technologie verstehen willst, die richtigen Fragen stellst und dafür sorgst, dass aus einer guten Idee eine funktionierende Lösung wird.
 Zusatzinformationen
 Was können wir Dir bieten?
 viel Gestaltungsspielraum für eigene Ideen und Initiativen
 Abwechslung durch vielfältige Aufgaben sowie eine inspirierende Zusammenarbeit und Austausch mit Kollegen und Kolleginnen unterschiedlicher Disziplinen
 eine tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem motivierten Team
 einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
 flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
 interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und perspektivische Karriereplanung im Rahmen unserer hauseigenen Weiterbildungsacademy „Marcel Classes“
 neben unseren Teamevents und kulturellen Initiativen kannst Du Dich auf unterschiedliche Well-Being Angebote und weitere Benefits wie unser Employee Assistance Program freuen
 Wir wollen, dass unser Team so vielfältig ist wie die Projekte, die wir für unsere Kunden umsetzen dürfen. Diskriminierung aufgrund von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, Herkunft oder sexueller Orientierung und Identität hat bei uns keinen Platz. Diversität sehen wir als Bereicherung für uns und unsere Kunden an. Unser Ziel ist eine Unternehmenskultur, in der alle Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter in ihrer Individualität respektiert werden und Wertschätzung erfahren.
 Du suchst noch mehr Einblicke?
 Dann schaue auf unserem Instagramkanal oder auf LinkedIn vorbei.

The Owner persona relies on Service Fusion to get high-level visibility into business health, track job profitability, manage online reputation, and make data-driven decisions.
As Product Manager, you’ll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Service Fusion Owner experience. You’ll use customer discovery, product analytics, feedback synthesis, AI-enabled workflows, and cross-functional partnerships to increase business owner engagement, drive expansion revenue, broaden platform retention, and establish Service Fusion as an indispensable command center.

 Launch and iterate on high-impact capabilities across reporting, business analytics, custom dashboards, reputation management/reviews, customer communication insights, and financial oversight tools. 
 Strengthen Service Fusion’s reporting infrastructure by balancing immediate insights delivery with long-term investments in data accuracy, scalability, and automated intelligence. 
 Deeply Understand Service Business Owners

 Lead discovery, usability testing, beta feedback analysis, and product analytics to identify high-value insights and reporting gaps. 
 Translate complex business and data requirements into simple, intuitive reporting tools and actionable dashboards tailored for non-technical business leaders.

 Skills And Experience Needed For Success In This Role
 5+ years in product management, ideally in B2B SaaS, reporting/analytics platforms, or workflow-heavy business software. 
 Experience owning customer-facing product areas and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes. 
 Strong ability to turn customer discovery, data analytics, and business goals into clear product strategy and roadmap decisions. 
 Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, including adoption, retention, engagement, customer satisfaction, and feature usage. 
 Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams across data engineering, software engineering, design, GTM, support, customer success, and leadership. 
 Excellent communicator who can engage both executive stakeholders and hands-on delivery teams.
